description: Caravaggio — Colore: Antique green & beige Codice: 5604 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Damask Scala: Large Altezza: 140.5 cm Rapporto: 64 cm × 94 cm Toni: Green The late-16th-century Italian painter CARAVAGGIO’s dramatic and affecting brushwork and scenery ushered in the Baroque style in Europe. The melodrama of CARAVAGGIO is made monumental with feathery plumes and exaggerated flowers that tower over the field of moody color in this fabric. Vivid in design, the striking pattern is a singular work of art.
